name: manual_9457a0
claim: Do not treat a GGUF model id as Windows-only evidence when classifying LAN peers; LM Studio on macOS serves GGUF too, so accept an explicit Mac candidate whenever positive Mac evidence exists

decisions.notes: 2026-10-25: orama #445 pushed head refused an explicit MAC_IP whose LM Studio listed any id containing gguf and recorded it as a Windows peer; c336ba68 (pushed as 5cfdf0e6) accepts mac_evidence or no win_evidence
